name: blm_claims_near
description: US federal mining claims (BLM MLRS) within a radius of a latitude/longitude — e.g. claims staked around a lithium, gold or uranium deposit in Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Wyoming. Returns the total count in the radius plus a page of claims (each page sorted by distance): BLM case serial number, claim name, type (lode / placer / mill site / tunnel site), status (Active, Filed, Closed…), recorded acres, distance, and an MLRS case-record link. Geometry is the recorded PLSS land description, not the staked boundary.

status.description: Which claims: "open" (default — every claim not closed: Active, Filed, Under Review, On Appeal…), "active" (disposition exactly Active), "closed", or "all".

claim_type.description: Optional claim type filter: lode, placer, mill_site or tunnel_site.

after_object_id.description: Paging cursor: pass next_after_object_id from the previous page (default: first page)

name: blm_claims_in_bbox
description: US federal mining claims (BLM MLRS) inside a latitude/longitude bounding box (up to 2° on a side). Returns the total count in the box and a page of claims: BLM case serial number, claim name, lode/placer/mill-site type, status, acres, mapped center and an MLRS case-record link.

status.description: Which claims: "open" (default — every claim not closed: Active, Filed, Under Review, On Appeal…), "active" (disposition exactly Active), "closed", or "all".

claim_type.description: Optional claim type filter: lode, placer, mill_site or tunnel_site.

after_object_id.description: Paging cursor: pass next_after_object_id from the previous page (default: first page)

name: blm_claims_case
description: One BLM mining claim by case serial number (MLRS, e.g. "NV101474832") or legacy serial (e.g. "NMC1018964"): claim name, type, status, recorded acres, patented flag, the full PLSS legal land description (meridian, township, range, section, aliquot parts), how well BLM could map it, the mapped bounding box, and the MLRS case-record link.

case_id.description: MLRS case serial number (e.g. NV101474832) or legacy serial (e.g. NMC1018964)

name: blm_claims_summary
description: Counts of US federal mining claims (BLM MLRS) within a radius of a point, broken down by claim type and status, with total recorded acres — how heavily staked is the ground around a deposit or project site, and how much of it is active versus closed.

status.description: Which claims: "open" (default — every claim not closed: Active, Filed, Under Review, On Appeal…), "active" (disposition exactly Active), "closed", or "all".
